---
title: "Ablation Study: Orben 2019 (NHB) - MCS Total"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

This document contains the ablation study for the MCS Total multiverse dataset
from Orben & Przybylski (2019, *Nature Human Behaviour*). Every decision is
fixed to one option in turn, importance estimates are recomputed on the reduced
multiverse, and the resulting importance vectors are compared across methods
and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r mcs-load-data}
mv_mcs <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total") |>
  expand_y_variable()
```

## Ablation Study

```{r mcs-ablation-run}
ablation_mcs <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_mcs,
  colname_metric = "effect",
  post_process_importances = function(imp) {
    imp |>
      aggregate_onehot_importances()
  }
)
```

### Inter-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
vis_inter_method_stability(ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Intra-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-plot}
vis_intra_method_stability(ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary)
```
